text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: “—For the aforementioned reasons, we will not be challenging the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe this year either.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takarazuka Kinen,
Duramente gathered members of her clan
to explain her plans for the year.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...I'm sure many people had high hopes that this would finally be the year."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry
for betraying you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: However, fulfilling our family's long-cherished wish is my dream as well. Next year, without fail—

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Please don't say such sad things
like I betrayed you.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll support whichever path you choose.
It goes without saying!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
To want to shoulder everything...
Your daughter is truly admirable, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, truly.
I'm so proud of you, Dura.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Dad...

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate C
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is truly a long-cherished dream, and every single one of us is placing our hopes on you."

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate C
text_block_list.text: Even so, just because the world you've always yearned for might finally be within reach, there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate C
text_block_list.text:
What's important is what you wish to accomplish.
That you desire to achieve it!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text:
“—We want *you*
to become the strongest in the world.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text:
Dura. Just as everyone in our family has done...
show me your own version of the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...It's so warm.
My heart is always full.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...From everyone.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It was entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That is,

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Indeed...—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ――It is "Here."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Flowing through this body...
are their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the Takarazuka Kinen arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Duramente was... showing more focus than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what kind of world
stretches out inside of her.
But perhaps, it's—
choice_data_list: (It must be so clear and serene.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I'm going to win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome!
Come on in, super-spotlight Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The spectators, and us as well...
Everyone is striving to reach you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: âI know.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Today...
I came to look everyone in the eye."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You finally noticed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "In that case, with the utmost respect! —I'll give you something to look up to."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Dura-san...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I heard about the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. I don't know the reason, but still..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Getting to run with you so much more...
makes me really happy, Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I kept my promise
to become stronger than I was before."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Let's race,
Dura-san!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even the absolute best among you...
I shall take it all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Finally, I can stand on the same
starting line as everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure it'll be fine.
I've... trained hard too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san...
Will I ever be able to close the distance between us—?
